purpose: Independent fresh prospective validation of the exact M10W23 MMO1 LONG micro-momentum formula inside the M10W25B prefix-causal high-ATR bullish coverage_class=NEITHER cohort after M10W25C retained STRONG_CANDIDATE status.

decision_grid.frequency: M15 boundaries represented by exact M1 timestamps with minute divisible by 15

target_regime.D1: EMA20 > EMA30 > EMA40 using fully closed D1 bars
target_regime.H4: EMA20 > EMA30 using fully closed H4 bars
target_regime.H1: TORYS MACD line(6,13,4) > 0 using fully closed H1 bars
target_regime.H1_ATR: Wilder ATR14 percentile rank over trailing 100 fully closed H1 bars >= 0.67

causal_coverage.long_presence: Exact M10W25 prefix-causal primary-state plus raw-first-turn plus branch-selection implementation; no completed-pair or future-exit requirement for window presence
causal_coverage.short_presence: Exact frozen M10P and M10P2 causal activation implementations
causal_coverage.window: floor each causal activation to its M15 window

feature_definitions.last_closed_m1: latest M1 bar with open_time + 1 minute <= decision
feature_definitions.m1_up_close_count5: count among the five closed M1 bars where close > open

candidate.entry: Exact M1 at decision; ask = M1 open + spread_points * XAUUSD point
candidate.exit: Exact M1 at decision + 240 minutes; bid = M1 open

data.source: Reviewed bounded CSV adapter verified append journal copied to a per-M10W26 private snapshot under the adapter update lock

required_outputs: private snapshot receipt and data-quality audit
